entities.name: Insurance Master
entities.description: This contains the insurance company details.

entities.name: Medics
entities.description: Details of Active Medics of Type Providers (DR), Medical Assistant (MA), Clinical Staff(RN), Office Staff (ST) and Billing Staff (BL).

entities.name: Referring Doctor
entities.description: This contains the referring provider details.

entities.name: Adjusters
entities.description: Contains the adjuster's information.

entities.name: Attorneys
entities.description: Contains the attorney's information.

entities.name: Employers
entities.description: Contains the employer's information.

entities.name: Guarantor
entities.description: This contains the guarantor's information.

entities.name: Patient Demographics
entities.description: This contains the patient's basic demographics information.

entities.name: Patient Insurance
entities.description: This contains the patient's insurance information like Patient Name, Insurance name, Plan ID, Group Number etc. There is no subfolder for this.

entities.name: Vaccination
entities.description: This exports the vaccine records that are administered using the options 'Vaccination on this visit' and 'Vaccination not associated with this visit'. The Scheduled vaccines are exported. The vaccines which are 'Not Tracked' are not exported. Once the vaccine is inactivated in the vaccine it is not available for further selection. However, if this vaccine was administered then it does get exported.

entities.name: Health Maintenance
entities.description: Health maintenance details are exported only for the tests which are in Due or Tentative states. The history is not exported. Type of tests for which data exported are: Lab / Rad / Consult / Procedure.

entities.name: Family History
entities.description: All the latest family history data is exported for patients.

entities.name: Past Medical Hist
entities.description: Past medical history data is exported as per the latest encounter status for the patients. Ailments are also exported.

entities.name: Surgery
entities.description: This contains the surgical history records of the patient. This data is exported as per the face sheet data for the patient.

entities.name: Allergy
entities.description: This contains the allergy data of the patient. This data is exported as per the face sheet data for the patient.

entities.name: Current Medication
entities.description: Current medication data is exported as per the latest encounter status for the patients.

entities.name: Social History
entities.description: This contains the Social history records of the patient. Social history data is exported as per the latest encounter status for the patients.

entities.name: Legal Documents
entities.description: This contains patient records which have one or more Legal Documents attached to their account in Benchmark EHR. It typically lists patient's basic information and the Legal record related information as input in Benchmark EHR. If documents are HTML, then they are converted to PDF, else copied as is. It contains a specific column labeled "File" which contains path of the attachment. For ex. CHART01/ DOCLD_1974.pdf Here, CHART01 is the folder and the DOCLD_1974 corresponds to

entities.name: Other Documents
entities.description: This contains patient records which have one or more Other Documents attached to their record in Benchmark EHR. It typically lists patient's basic information and the Other Document related information as input in Benchmark EHR. It contains a specific column labeled "File" which contains path of the attachment. For ex. CHART01/DOCOT_5421.pdf

entities.name: Enc Attach Docs
entities.description: This contains patient records attached to their account in Benchmark EHR. It typically lists patient's basic information and the Other Document related information as input in Benchmark EHR. Multiple attachments in an Encounter For ex. CHART01/DOCEN_23166.pdf Here, CHART01 is the folder and the DOCEN_23166 corresponds to the physical file stored under the Folder CHART01.

entities.name: Old Progress Notes
entities.description: All the documents (DocType: OPA) attached to the patient account are exported. If documents are HTML, then they are converted to PDF, else copied as is. Alongwith the files attached, excel file is also exported with following fields. It contains a specific column labeled "File" which contains path of the attachment. For ex. CHART01/PROG_53942.pdf Here, CHART01 is the folder and the PROG_53942 corresponds to the physical file stored under the Folder CHART01.

entities.name: Messages
entities.description: All the patient messages that are added to patient record from Message Compose screen.

entities.name: Future Appointments
entities.description: All patient appointments (today and onwards) with status as Scheduled or Tentative are exported.

entities.name: Vitals
entities.description: This contains the patient's basic demographics information. We only export vitals recorded as per the latest encounter.

entities.name: Diagnosis Code
entities.description: This is the list of diagnosis codes as per the assessment in patient's encounter.

entities.name: CPT Codes
entities.description: This is the list of CPT codes as per the assessment in patient's encounter.

entities.name: HCPC Codes
entities.description: This is the list of HCPC codes as per the assessment in patient's encounter.

entities.name: CCD
entities.description: This contains the CCD details.

entities.name: Prescriptions
entities.description: This contains the Rx details of the patient. All the drugs ever prescribed for the patient in Benchmark EHR are exported.

entities.name: Lab Results
entities.description: All the received Lab Results will be exported.

entities.name: Rad Results
entities.description: All the received Radiology Results will be exported.

entities.name: Procedure Orders
entities.description: All procedure orders and results are exported.

entities.name: Consults
entities.description: All patient consults are exported.

entities.name: Enc Progress Notes
entities.description: This contains patient visit records. It typically lists patient's basic information and the Visit/Encounter record related information available in Benchmark EHR. The progress notes (My Notes) along with the attached progress notes are exported only for encounters that are closed. If there are multiple My Notes created then only the default My note gets exported. It contains a specific column labeled "File" which contains path of the attachment. For ex. CHART01/PROG_53942.pdf Here, CHART01 is the folder and the PROG_53942 corresponds to the physical file stored under the Folder CHART01.

entities.name: Procedure Notes
entities.description: This contains patient records which have Procedures attached to their account in Benchmark EHR. Procedure notes documents for the non-zero duration encounters are exported. It contains a specific column labeled "File" which contains path of the attachment. For ex. CHART01/PROC_68966.pdf Here, CHART01 is the folder and the PROC_68966 corresponds to the physical file stored under the Folder CHART01.

entities.name: Letters
entities.description: This contains patient records which have one or more Letter-in and Letter-out records attached to their record. All the letters which are sent out with status 'sent' or incoming letters attached to the patient's record are exported. Any attachments with the outgoing letter are NOT exported. If the letter is sent to multiple recipients then a consolidated PDF with multiple letters is generated. For A letter is sent To: Mary Smith and To: John Smith and CC: Mark Smithe then a single PDF is created with all the three letters. The excel sheet has the following details of the letters. In case of multiple recipients only one row is generated with the 'To-From' column displaying the first recipients name.
notes: Any attachments with the outgoing letter are NOT exported.

entities.name: All Vitals
entities.description: This contains Vitals for all Encounters.

entities.name: Lab Test Result Values
entities.description: Lab results with status as 'Received' or 'Complete' are exported. This exports discrete result tests. – All the lab test results with status R & C will be exported. – Test results from Deleted encounters, DE/FS encounters are also exported.

entities.name: Patient Cases
entities.description: Contains the list of Patients and their Cases.

entities.name: Patient Notes
entities.description: All Patient Notes saved for a Patient in the table TRN_NOTES>TN_TYPE>CN.

entities.name: Patient Alert
entities.description: All Patients Alerts except the Alerts that are deleted.

entities.name: Past Appointments
entities.description: All Patient Appointments of current and previous dates with Visit Status Scheduled, Tentative, Arrived, With Nurse, With MA, For MA, With Doc, Complete, Ready for Nurse, Ready for Doc, Ready for Checkout, Ready for Review.

entities.name: Billing Ledger
entities.description: Exports the Ledger for Run Date. Ledger will be exported for billed claims only. We do not export claim wise ledger.

entities.name: Billing Claims
entities.description: Exports all Billed Claims for the Patient. Claims which are billed only those claims will be exported. Void claims will not be exported. UB04 data will NOT be exported – No CMS 1500 / UB04 forms will be exported.

fields.name: Commented [1]: Same fields (BLH_TOS_CODE) with two different name (Type Of Service CODE and Type Of Service Name) in current functionality. Need to discuss. BLH_AB_START_TIME

entities.name: Billing Charges
entities.description: Exports all Billed Claims and their Charges for the Patient. Void Charges are not exported.

entities.name: Patient Advance
entities.description: Data of the Patient's Advance which is Moved to Advance or Opening Advance will be exported. Only billed claims data will be exported.

entities.name: Statements
entities.description: Exports the Statement for Run Date. Latest Patient statement will be exported for billed claims only. For ex, If we have a statement generated for a patient Dummy test on 01-012017, 01-01-2018 and 01-01-2019. Then, the statement will get generated for 01-01-2019. Which is the latest. We do not export claim wise statements. File name with path - For ex. validation_notes: Field counts sourced from enrichment JSON which handles PDF line-break artifacts better than raw regex parsing.
Independent parse found 1138 fields vs enrichment's 1146 — 8-field discrepancy due to line breaks splitting field names across PDF pages (entities 8, 38, 44).
11 of 47 entities lack explicit field lists: document-type entities export as PDFs, CCD as HTML/XML, and a few small entities have only prose descriptions.
No per-field descriptions, data types, value sets, or foreign key documentation exists in the source PDF.
